title: My Sister Forged A Deed And Sold My Inherited Home. So I Reclaimed It And She Now Trims My Hedges.
description: My sister forged a deed of trust and sold my $280K inherited Victorian home, stealing everything. I found a hidden letter, proved the fraud in probate court, and reclaimed the deed. Now she trims my hedges every weekend in a 'Planted Lies' apron as a historic-district tour trolley rolls by. #PropertyFraud #ProbateJustice #KarmaStory
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY HOME AND NOW SHE TRIMS MY HEDGES
pinned_comment: If your own sister forged a deed and stole your $280K inheritance after 20 years of caregiving, would you have forgiven her or fought in court? Share your story below.
